## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Sòng-period translation of a Sanskrit *śrāmaṇera*-precepts sūtra by **Dānapāla** 施護 ([施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7)) at the imperial Yìjīngyuàn 譯經院, late 10th to early 11th century.

**Abstract**

The text is one of the late Sòng translations of Indian *śrāmaṇera*-precept manuals, supplementing the older Chinese translations ([KR6k0060](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0060), [KR6k0061](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0061)). Dānapāla's translation reflects the Indian Mūlasarvāstivāda recension of the novice precepts as practised in 10th-century India. The text was used as a supplementary practical handbook for novice training in Sòng-period Chinese monasteries.
